title: Merodach-Baladan
summary: Babylonian ruler who slew Akises, in Polyhistor (Cory 1876). The text gives months, not years.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Tier 2, CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 722 BC (seized the throne of Babylon)). No tier 1–4 birth year. Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was none none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 722, p. 44
reign.note: Table 2 (p. 40) has him ascend the throne on 1 Nisan 721 (next entry); CFAH inconsistency I23.
